summary: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on October 7, 2026 it entered a Securities Purchase Agreement with Huan Liu—its CEO, director and Chairman—to sell 100,000 Class B common shares at $3.30 per share for $330,000 gross, closing October 9, 2026. The issuance was a private placement exempt under Regulation S and/or Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b), with restricted securities, investment representations and no general solicitation. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed, and no premium, regulatory clock or break fee applies. This is a routine affiliated insider equity purchase, not a special situation; watch dilution, Class B voting concentration and governance optics of CEO-led financing.
